title: 10-Minute Gentle Balance Workout for Seniors | Chair Support Option
promise: 10 minutes to work on your balance
description: A gentle 10-minute balance routine for seniors. Follow along at your own pace — a sturdy chair is all you need.

segments.name: March in Place
segments.say: Let's start by marching in place. Gently lift your knees.

segments.name: Shoulder Rolls
segments.say: Now, roll your shoulders back, slowly and smoothly.

segments.name: Side Steps
segments.instruction: Step side to side, nice and easy
segments.say: Let's step side to side, nice and easy.

segments.name: Heel Raises
segments.instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
segments.say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly.
Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Sit to Stand
segments.instruction: Stand up slowly, then sit back down
segments.say: Sit near the front of your chair. Stand up slowly, then sit back down with control.
Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Single-Leg Balance
segments.instruction: Lift one foot just off the floor
segments.cue: Hold your chair the whole time
segments.say: Hold your chair, and lift one foot just off the floor. Switch sides halfway.
Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Side Leg Raises
segments.instruction: Lift your leg out to the side
segments.say: Hold your chair, and lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.
Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Heel-to-Toe Walk
segments.instruction: Place one heel in front of your toes
segments.say: Walk heel to toe, like on a tightrope. Take your time.
Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Toe Taps
segments.instruction: Tap your toes forward, one at a time
segments.say: Tap your toes forward, one foot at a time.

segments.name: Deep Breathing
segments.say: Let's slow down. Breathe in through your nose, and out through your mouth.

segments.name: Calf Stretch
segments.instruction: Step back and press your heel down
segments.say: Step one foot back and gently press your heel down. Hold the stretch.

segments.name: Neck Stretch
segments.instruction: Tilt your head gently to the side
segments.say: Gently tilt your head to one side, then the other.
